description: R08.T14.f's vector gates: R08.T13.c1's case gate re-run against the four committed references' vector radiance I with the polarisation correction, each case through the path classifyRegime gives it under a clear sky (routed, the bake at m <= 2 from R08.T14.d.1), beside the route with the bake cut to m = 0 alone and to m <= 1 (routedByModes, R08.T14.d.1), the analytic path with the correction (diagnostic), the uncorrected twin against the vector I, and c1's own record, the uncorrected twin against the scalar I (caseGate.json); R08.T13's surface irradiance against the vector flux aggregate, uncorrected; the ground's irradiance under every aggregate's sun on both paths, its sky's irradiance built over the thick table as the kernels' is (groundIrradiance, R08.T14.d.4); each case's tables; and giant-deck through its deck (R08.T15.a.2): its route over the geometries above the split, the deck's multiple-scattering part cut to m < 3 and m < 6, its sky-lit radiance at the deck's modes, its floor white, the case split as an envelope over its black floor and its white, each variant's tallies and twin ÷ reference by image, the bake's plane albedo against the aggregates and the deck's share of each orbit image (deck); its route below the split, the table below the deck uncorrected against the vector I, and the ground's flux against the vector flux (deck.routedBelow, R08.T15.b.2); and the Venus-class cases through their deck against their references' scalar radiance, the uncorrected twin above the split and the table below the deck beneath it, with the ground's flux against the scalar flux and R08.T12.b's flux sanity (deck.venusClass, R08.T15.b.2); and titan-class through its route, its whole column baked at m <= 2 with its correction, the channels its methane allows at their own wavelengths (ownWavelengths), its diffuse streams on their curved paths (curvedStreams) and its rows of a low sun without the horizon's first-order terms (horizonTerms false), against the vector I, its tallies by image at m <= 2 and at the cut modes, with the ground's flux under each aggregate against the vector flux, beside its analytic path with the correction (diagnostic) and each geometry's worst channel through both paths in edge units, |twin - ref| / (T + 4 sigma) (worstByGeometry) (titanClass, R08.T14.d.4); and jupiter-envelope, the hand Jupiter's medium over a black ground at green tau 20, its chromophore absorbing above its envelope's floor, through an envelope's route split at that floor as giant-deck's envelope variant is, over the disc and the limb against the vector I, tallied by image, with its upper medium's channels (jupiterEnvelope, R08.T16.a.2). Verdicts recorded, never gated. Written by vectorGate.test.ts; do not edit by hand.
